# 2 Kings Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 222v–223v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_002_page_001.jpg, 2KI_002_page_002.jpg, 2KI_002_page_003.jpg

---

**2:1** And-it-was when-YHWH was-about-to-take-up [beha'alot] Eliyahu in-the-storm-wind [ba-se'arah] to the-heavens, and-went Eliyahu and-Elisha from the-Gilgal.

**2:2** And-said Eliyahu to-Elisha: Stay here, please, for YHWH has-sent-me as-far-as Beit-El. And-said Elisha: As-YHWH-lives and-as-your-soul-lives [chey nafshekha], I-will-not leave-you. And-they-went-down to-Beit-El.

**2:3** And-came-out the-sons of-the-prophets [beney ha-nevi'im] who [were] in-Beit-El to Elisha and-said to-him: Do-you-know that today YHWH is-taking your-master from-over your-head? And-he-said: Also I know — be-silent [hecharishu].

**2:4** And-said to-him Eliyahu: Elisha, stay here, please, for YHWH has-sent-me to-Yericho. And-he-said: As-YHWH-lives and-as-your-soul-lives, I-will-not leave-you. And-they-came to-Yericho.

**2:5** And-drew-near the-sons of-the-prophets who [were] in-Yericho to Elisha and-said to-him: Do-you-know that today YHWH is-taking your-master from-over your-head? And-he-said: Also I know — be-silent.

**2:6** And-said to-him Eliyahu: Stay here, please, for YHWH has-sent-me to the-Yarden. And-he-said: As-YHWH-lives and-as-your-soul-lives, I-will-not leave-you. And-they-went, the-two-of-them.

**2:7** And-fifty men from the-sons of-the-prophets went and-stood at-a-distance, opposite [mi-neged]; and-the-two-of-them stood by the-Yarden.

**2:8** And-took Eliyahu his-mantle [addarto] and-rolled-it-up [vayiglom] and-struck the-waters, and-they-were-divided [vayechatssu] here and-here, and-they-crossed, the-two-of-them, on-dry-ground [be-charavah].

**2:9** And-it-was as-they-crossed, and-Eliyahu said to-Elisha: Ask — what shall-I-do for-you before I-am-taken from-you? And-said Elisha: Let-there-be, please, a-double-portion [pi-shnayim] of-your-spirit [ruachakha] upon-me.

**2:10** And-he-said: You-have-made-difficult [hiqshita] to-ask. If you-see me being-taken from-you, it-shall-be so for-you; and-if not, it-shall-not be.

**2:11** And-it-was they [were] walking, walking and-speaking, and-behold — a-chariot of-fire [rekhev esh] and-horses of-fire [susey esh], and-they-separated between the-two-of-them. And-went-up Eliyahu in-the-storm-wind [ba-se'arah] to the-heavens.

**2:12** And-Elisha [was] seeing and-he [was] crying-out: My-father, my-father [avi avi]! The-chariot of-Yisra'el and-its-horsemen [rekhev yisra'el u-farashav]! And-he-saw-him no more. And-he-grasped his-garments and-tore-them into-two pieces [li-shnayim qera'im].

**2:13** And-he-picked-up the-mantle of-Eliyahu that had-fallen from-upon-him, and-returned and-stood on the-bank of-the-Yarden.

**2:14** And-he-took the-mantle of-Eliyahu that had-fallen from-upon-him and-struck the-waters and-said: Where [is] YHWH, God of-Eliyahu — indeed he [aph hu]? And-he-struck the-waters and-they-were-divided here and-here, and-Elisha crossed-over.

**2:15** And-saw-him the-sons of-the-prophets who [were] in-Yericho from-opposite, and-they-said: The-spirit of-Eliyahu has-rested [nachah] upon Elisha. And-they-came to-meet-him and-bowed-down to-him to-the-ground.

**2:16** And-they-said to-him: Behold, please, there-are with your-servants fifty men, sons of-strength [beney chayil]. Let-them-go, please, and-let-them-seek your-master, lest the-Spirit of-YHWH has-carried-him [nasa'o] and-cast-him on-one of-the-mountains or in-one of-the-valleys. And-he-said: You-shall-not send.

**2:17** And-they-pressed-him [vayiftseru vo] until he-was-ashamed [ad bosh], and-he-said: Send. And-they-sent fifty men and-they-searched three days and-did-not find-him.

**2:18** And-they-returned to-him — and-he [was] staying in-Yericho — and-he-said to-them: Did-I-not say to-you, do-not go?

**2:19** And-said the-men of-the-city to Elisha: Behold, please, the-location [moshav] of-the-city [is] good, as my-lord sees; but the-waters [are] bad [ra'im] and-the-land [is] causing-miscarriage [meshakkalet].

**2:20** And-he-said: Bring to-me a-new bowl [tsalochit chadashah] and-put there salt [melach]. And-they-brought [it] to-him.

**2:21** And-he-went-out to the-spring of-the-waters [motsa ha-mayim] and-cast there salt and-said: Thus says YHWH: I-have-healed [ripiti] these waters; there-shall-not be from-there anymore death [mavet] or-miscarriage [meshakkelet].

**2:22** And-were-healed the-waters to this day, according-to-the-word of-Elisha that he-spoke.

**2:23** And-he-went-up from-there to-Beit-El, and-he [was] going-up on-the-way, and-small youths [ne'arim qetannim] came-out from the-city and-mocked-him [vayitqalsu vo] and-said to-him: Go-up, bald-one [aleh qereach]! Go-up, bald-one!

**2:24** And-he-turned behind-him and-saw-them and-cursed-them [vayeqalelem] in-the-name of-YHWH. And-came-out two she-bears [shtayim dubbim] from the-forest [min ha-ya'ar] and-tore [vatevaq'na] from-them forty-two boys [yeladim].

**2:25** And-he-went from-there to-Mount Carmel [Har ha-Karmel], and-from-there he-returned to-Shomron.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — beha'alot:** The hiphil infinitive of *'alah* — "when YHWH was about to cause to go up." The agency is divine; Elijah does not ascend on his own.

**v.8 — vayiglom:** A rare verb (only here in the Hebrew Bible), meaning to fold or roll up. The mantle-strike echoes Moses and the Reed Sea, Joshua and the Jordan.

**v.9 — pi-shnayim:** Literally "a mouth of two" — the double share. This is the inheritance term for the firstborn son (Deut 21:17). Elisha is asking to be Elijah's spiritual firstborn, not for twice Elijah's power.

**v.11 — rekhev esh:** The chariot and horses of fire separate the two prophets; the *se'arah* (storm-wind/whirlwind) is what actually takes Elijah up. He does not ride the chariot.

**v.12 — rekhev yisra'el u-farashav:** "The chariot of Israel and its horsemen" — Elisha's cry identifies Elijah as Israel's true military defense. This title will be reapplied to Elisha himself at his death (2 Kgs 13:14).

**v.23 — ne'arim qetannim:** The term *na'ar* can range from "child" to "young man." The mocking cry "Go up!" (*aleh*) may be a taunt referencing Elijah's ascent — "Go up like your master did!"

*— EMET*
